steps.path: Click the 5h, 7d or Cost chip in the bar along the bottom of the window
steps.headline: The Usage window, redone: one account at a time, with your use drawn against its limit.
steps.changed: Tabs pick the account. Under its limit bars, two charts share one timeline: how full the 7-day limit was (it drops at each reset), and tokens per day. Then each model's share.
steps.notice: You can see which days pushed your limit up, and when it reset, without boxes or tiles in the way.
steps.risk: The numbers here are made up.

steps.headline: 24 hours pairs your hourly use with the 5-hour limit.
steps.changed: The top line switches to the 5-hour limit, and the bars become tokens per hour. 2 weeks and 3 months use the 7-day limit.
steps.notice: Each range answers one question: am I burning through the 5-hour limit today, or the weekly one?
steps.risk: Hourly history is kept for the last day only; longer ranges are by day.

steps.headline: ChatGPT's tab adds its per-model limit and extra credits under the plan bars.
steps.changed: The same layout, plus the two lines you approved for the ChatGPT card.
steps.notice: Everything that can stop a ChatGPT reply is on one screen.
steps.risk: Those two lines appear only when ChatGPT reports them.

steps.headline: OpenRouter shows credit left and dollars spent per day instead of a limit.
steps.changed: OpenRouter has no plan limit, so there is no top line: credit left, then money spent per day, then each model's cost.
steps.notice: You see how fast your balance is going and which model is spending it.
steps.risk: Only shown once your OpenRouter key works.

steps.path: Settings → Assistant settings → Cloud providers, scrolled to the bottom
steps.headline: The same view sits at the bottom of Cloud providers, as you asked.
steps.changed: Under the accounts and your own API keys, a Usage heading and the same view as the window. The separate Usage tab is gone.
steps.notice: The popup and Settings always show identical numbers, because they are one piece.
steps.risk: You scroll past the account cards to reach it.
